question:
**Direction: Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the underlined group of words in the following sentence.**

Denmark has __**a type of government where power is held by the wealthiest members of society**__.
solution:
The correct answer is **"plutocracy."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Plutocracy"** means a government by the wealthy or a class that is extremely rich. (अमीरों द्वारा सरकार या अत्यंत अमीर वर्ग)

 
 
• **Example**: *The attack on the Bank of England was a gesture against the very symbol of **plutocracy**__.*
 
 
 
• The word is derived from the Greek words** "ploutos"** meaning wealth and **"kratos"** meaning power.
 
• In the given sentence, Denmark's form of government is described as being controlled by the wealthiest members of society, which fits the definition of plutocracy.
 
• Other examples of **plutocracies** include the Gilded Age in the United States and modern-day Russia.
 
• The correct answer is Option 2.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Democracy (Option 1) **refers to a government where power is held by the people or by elected representatives. (ऐसी सरकार जहां सत्ता जनता या निर्वाचित प्रतिनिधियों के पास होती है)
 
• **Monarchy (Option 3) **is a form of government where a monarch, such as a king or queen, holds the power. (सरकार का एक रूप जहां एक राजा, जैसे राजा या रानी, ​​सत्ता रखता है)
 
• **Oligarchy (Option 4)** is a government where power is held by a small group of people, often those who are wealthy or have a certain social status. (एक ऐसी सरकार जहां सत्ता लोगों के एक छोटे समूह के पास होती है, अक्सर वे लोग जो अमीर होते हैं या जिनकी एक निश्चित सामाजिक स्थिति होती है)
